summary: Charcode-obfuscated author URL stamped as attribution on outgoing rich-media messages
details: lib/Socket/messages-send.js contains a rich-media message builder that assigns sourceUrl (and in one branch imagePreviewUrl/videoHighResUrl) to a String.fromCharCode-obfuscated literal decoding to https://fiora.nixel.my.id/. Every rich-media/AIRich message produced by the library is stamped with this hardcoded author-controlled URL as the attribution source, and the destination is hidden behind charcode obfuscation rather than appearing as a plain string. No installer data, credentials, environment variables, or filesystem contents are read or transmitted; the URL is embedded in outbound WhatsApp message metadata visible to message recipients, not a network callback from the installer's host. The behavior is a covert author-branding side effect using the consumer's WhatsApp session, not exfiltration, silent-relay, or code execution against the installer.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
